title: ESQL: Infer not null for aggregated fields

timeline.message:
ESQL: Improve local folding of aggregates

Introduce a local rule for folding aggregates to take into account the
 aggregate intermediate state as oppose to that on the coordinator.
timeline.author: Costin Leau

timeline.message:
Since the majority of aggregations discard null values, filter them to
 begin with.
 | STATS x = min(a), y = sum(b) BY c
 becomes
 | WHERE a IS NOT NULL OR b IS NOT NULL
 | STATS x = min(a), y = sum(b) BY c

Fix #102787
